# Hackreation x ERI

> One-day hackathon (Oct 31, 2026, Milwaukee) hosted by Mitobyte with Employment Resources, Inc. (ERI), a Wisconsin nonprofit helping people with disabilities work without losing benefits. Theme: software that connects people with disabilities to jobs. All data is synthetic. Recommended stack: HTML/jQuery, PHP/MySQL, WordPress, Expo/Supabase.

## Start here
- [Essentials](wiki/ESSENTIALS.md): the one-page rules, data and numbers
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI coding assistants
- [Event](wiki/event/hackreation.md): schedule, challenges, judging rubric
